question.text: The sum of all the values of <math><mi>λ</mi></math> for which the set <math><mfenced close="}" open="{" separators="|"><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mi>y</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>:</mo><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>12</mn></mrow></mfenced><mo>∩</mo><mfenced close="}" open="{" separators="|"><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mi>y</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>:</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>λ</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> contains exactly one element is

solution.text:
For exactly one element, the line should be a tangent to the circle
Given line L: 4x+3y=λ
Circle S: x2+y2-6x+4y=12 has centre 3,-2, radius =5
Now, L will be a tangent to the circle if the distance of it from the centre of the circle is equal to the radius
∴p=r
43+3-2-λ5=5⇒λ=31,-19
⇒ Sum of all the values of λ is equal to 12
